_comment: Records-based valuation (ARV/AVM + CMA). The score says WHO to buy from; this says WHAT IT'S WORTH, so a lead becomes an OFFER. Tier 1 (this file's defaults) runs on recorded deed sales + assessor characteristics -- free/records data we already hold; no MLS. Tier 2 swaps the same engine onto MLS sold comps (photos/condition) for a retail CMA. The engine is identical; only the comp pool changes. Adjustment dollars are placeholders tuned to a Charlotte-area SFR baseline -- calibrate per submarket. Everything here is transparent and per-comp traceable, like a real appraisal adjustment grid.

offer.note: wholesale_* = as-is offer band as a fraction of estimated value. arv_rule_factor = the investor '70% rule': MAO = ARV*0.70 - repairs (computed only when repairs are supplied).
